question: In which bodily locations should this moon be meditated upon?
premises: The practitioner should meditate on this moon.
The navel and head are specified locations.
The heart is also specified as a location.
inference: One should meditate on this moon in the navel, the head, and the heart.
plain_english: O goddess, one should meditate on this moon in the navel, in the head, and in the heart.
